eventDetail.scope: The IEEE FutureGrid Conference & Expo is an international forum for researchers, industry professionals, utilities, manufacturers, policymakers, and students to present and discuss advances in future electric energy systems. The conference covers power systems, power electronics, industrial applications, renewable energy integration, electrification, energy storage, distributed energy resources, microgrids, HVDC and DC grids, artificial intelligence and machine learning for energy systems, digitalization, grid resilience, cybersecurity, power quality, advanced power conversion technologies, transportation electrification, and sustainable energy infrastructure. The conference promotes collaboration among academia, industry, utilities, and government to accelerate innovation and deployment of next-generation energy technologies.
